questions.subject: CS
questions.question: Outline the stages of the system lifecycle.
questions.answer: Investigation, analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance.
questions.explanation: The system lifecycle breaks development into phases; each phase has deliverables that feed the next.

questions.subject: Math
questions.question: Find $\frac{d}{dx}(x^3 \sin x)$.
questions.explanation: Apply the product rule: $(uv)' = u'v + uv'$, with $u=x^3$, $v=\sin x$.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A car accelerates uniformly from $0$ to $20\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ in $10\,\text{s}$. Calculate its acceleration.
questions.explanation: Uniform acceleration is the change in velocity over time.
